summary.en: The split look: paper for what is written, a dark bench behind real results, one accent that is the seam between them; Archivo semi-expanded for claims, JetBrains Mono for everything that really is code.
summary.zh: split 的样式：写的东西在纸面上，真实结果在深色台面上，唯一的强调色就是两者之间的接缝；主张用 Archivo 半宽体，真正的代码一律 JetBrains Mono。

fits: Developer tools whose input maps line by line to an output: generators, compilers, config files, CLIs with a report, diff tools.
notFor: Products with no visible output; benchmark launches; a one-screen app.

intent.en: Show cause and effect as two sides of one edit: the line written, the result it made.
intent.zh: 把因果呈现为一次编辑的两边：写下的一行，和它做出的结果。

content.en: Real outputs (frames, renders, pages) and the real input text that made them (a request, a list, file lines, a command, a one-line diff).
content.zh: 真实的输出（画格、渲染、页面）和做出它们的真实输入（请求、列表、文件行、命令、一行 diff）。

fits.zh: 输入与输出逐行对应的开发者工具：生成器、编译器、配置文件、带报告的命令行、diff 工具。

notFor.zh: 没有可见输出的产品；跑分发布；单屏应用。

en: The seam within ΔE00 20 of a colour filling a result it crosses reads as part of the result: take `diff-plum` for green or teal results.
Never dim, tint or grain a result: the seam already says which side is in play.
zh: 接缝色与它穿过的结果里大面积颜色 ΔE00 小于 20 会被看成结果的一部分：绿或青的结果换 `diff-plum`。
结果不加暗、不染色、不加颗粒：接缝已经说明哪边在说话。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
